title: Unit
description: A combat unit. All numeric values are authored as decimals and converted to Q16.16 fixed-point at load. Values feed both the simulation and the cost-curve validator, so an inaccurate stat is a balance bug, not a cosmetic one.

blurb.description: One line the reinforcements dock shows on hover (GH-153), under the cost and the doctrine tags. It must say something the tile cannot already: a role, a restriction, or the one thing this unit is for. Never lore, never a restatement of a stat that is already on screen. Optional — a unit without one simply shows no description line, which is why this is not required and why no default is supplied.

voice.description: Which voice pool answers for this unit (WP-AU1 §3). Optional: absent, it follows the role -- infantry, at_team, sniper, support, artillery -> infantry; mbt, ifv, apc, technical, recon, aa -> crew; engineer, eod -> engineer; drone, gunship -> air. Declare it only where the role is wrong, the way `mobility.wheeled` is declared where the role default is wrong. Presentation only: the sim never reads it.

upgrades.description: Upgrade tracks (spec 2026-09-15 §4.3). Each tier's patch is the cumulative DELTA over base on the closed whitelist; tiers are monotone. Bought per track from the brigade account; applied by @lions/data's applyUpgrades before the sim registers the type. KDF units only.

hp.description: Structural integrity. Most kills come from the component table, not HP depletion.

front.description: RHA-equivalent mm. Facing arc is ±60 degrees.

aps.description: Trophy-class active protection. Finite magazine is what makes saturation attacks a viable enemy doctrine.

transport_slots.description: Seats for infantry. Passengers ride at the vehicle’s speed, cannot be shot at while aboard, and bail out hurt if it is destroyed.

can_embark.description: Can ride inside a transport. Defaults from role: infantry, at_team, artillery, engineer, sniper and support dismount and can embark; mbt, apc, ifv, technical and drone cannot. Set explicitly only to override that.

figures.description: GH-707: men in the team, mirroring the GLB's figure count (the sim never reads art). A team loses one man at each 1/figures share of its hp.

wounds.description: GH-707: a man lost from this team may fall wounded instead of dead. Absent = he always dies.

bleed_s.description: Seconds a wounded man lasts untreated.

type.description: Unit id of the wounded man shed (role `wounded`).

in_place.description: A one-figure unit goes down itself instead of shedding a man (civilians).

can_carry.description: GH-707: when present this carrier seats ONLY these roles (an ambulance: ["wounded"]).

stabilise_radius.description: GH-707: tiles around this unit inside which a friendly wounded does not bleed.

rescue.description: GH-707: a medic. How far it looks for wounded, how long it treats one, and its speed multiplier dragging (one man) or carrying (a stretcher team).

reshapes_terrain.description: D9-class. Opens assault lanes and forces flow-field recompute.

wheeled.description: Rides on wheels or tracks, so a boulder field (map symbol `b`) stops it where infantry walk through. Absent means derived from `role`: everything outside the dismounted set (infantry, at_team, artillery, engineer, sniper, support) is wheeled. The derivation is wrong for two shipped units, one each way, and that is why this field exists -- `rocket_battery` is a Grad on a 6x6 truck and declares role "artillery" exactly as `mortar_team`, four men and a tube, does (so it says true); `manpad_team` is two men and a launcher with role "aa", which `gun_truck` shares (so it says false, GH-247). Set it only where the default gets a unit wrong.

gear.description: Running gear, for a mobility kill (#706). `wheels`: the first mobility hit only SLOWS the hull (half speed) and a second leaves it stuck. `tracks` (the default, and the behaviour before #706): one mobility hit leaves it stuck. NOT the same as `wheeled`, which means a vehicle rather than foot and is true of a tracked Lavi. Pinned against tools/src/meshes/running-gear-recipes.ts by tools/src/mobility_gear.test.ts: a recipe with wheels and no track is `wheels`, one with a track is `tracks`. Air types ignore it.

halts_to_fire.description: Fires only from a halt: the unit stops, kneels (KNEEL_DROP_TICKS) before its first shot, fires while down, and gets up (KNEEL_RISE_TICKS) before it moves on; it never fires while its feet move. Absent means derived: armed, not wheeled, not air, not a kamikaze -- every foot unit that shoots, and no vehicle, aircraft or charge squad. Set it only where the derivation gets a unit wrong. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-infantry-halt-to-fire.md.

domain.description: Where the unit moves. `air` flies: it ignores terrain blocking and is engageable only by weapons whose can_target includes "air". Absent means ground, so every existing unit is unchanged.

weight.description: Presentation only. How the DRAWN hull leans, lags and settles; read by the three.js renderer (packages/render/src/three/units/vehicle-weight-params.ts) and by nothing in the sim -- packages/sim never reads this block, and no engine change is needed to add a unit here. Absent means the role default. `mass_class` is the cheap authoring surface; the four numbers below are an escape hatch for a unit the class gets wrong, and an explicit number overrides the class on that one axis only.

mass_class.description: Selects a whole parameter set from the renderer's mass-class table. Overridden per-axis by any of the four numbers below.

pitch_deg.description: Nose-up pitch a standing start draws, degrees. The schema caps it at 6, which is NOT the recoil bound: the hull recoil pitches 3.4 degrees (MESH_HULL_PITCH_RAD, 0.06 rad), and every role default and mass class in the renderer's tables stays under that so a weight lean reads smaller than a gun's recoil -- pinned by vehicle-weight-params.test.ts, not here. An authored value between 3.4 and 6 validates and draws a lean larger than the recoil.

roll_deg.description: Roll at the unit's own full turn rate, degrees.

lag_tiles.description: How far the drawn hull trails the sim at cruise, tiles. Capped at 0.09 -- the combined drawn-vs-sim offset budget is 0.25 tiles (MAX_DRAWN_OFFSET_TILES) and the hull recoil already spends 0.16 of it, so this ceiling makes it impossible to author a value that breaks that bound even if the renderer's own clamp were removed.

settle_s.description: The settle spring's 2% settling time, seconds.

signature.description: How visible this unit is. Low signature is the core of enemy asymmetry.

firing_signature_mult.description: Shooting reveals you. This number is why.

weapons.description: At most two: the sim fires weapon slots 0 and 1 (sim.ts, `slot < 2`) and never reads a third.

penetration.description: RHA-equivalent mm. Compared against effective armour through a normal CDF, not a threshold.

suppression.description: Applied on near miss. High-suppression low-damage weapons are valuable and should be.

collateral_risk.description: Feeds ROE scoring. The player must be able to see this before firing.

fires_from_building.description: Whether this weapon fires while its unit is garrisoned. False for indirect fire (a mortar needs open sky over the tube; lead ruling 2026-10-14, G4). validate_data requires false on any mortar or rocket weapon, or any weapon declaring "indirect": true, of a unit with the garrison ability.

indirect.description: E2 (GH-709): fires on a target its side has identified with no line of sight of its own, whatever its type. Mortar and rocket are indirect by type either way. Only the sight rule moves: structure damage, anti-armour ranking, projectile speed and range falloff stay with the weapon type.

submunitions.description: E3 (GH-709): the round bursts where it lands (on the target if it hit, otherwise its scatter point) into count bomblets, each placed within scatter_tiles and resolved as a detonation in place: soft units only, nobody underground, garrisoned or carried, no structure. The parent's own damage and splash_tiles are not applied. ROE judges each bomblet as a flagged-zone stray and charges danger-close once per round, at twice disproportionate_ordnance_penalty, where the bomblets land.

demolition_time_s.description: Seconds a `demolish` unit must hold station to bring a building down. Absent means 5.0, which is what every demolisher did before the field existed.

demolition_method.description: How this unit takes a building apart. `charges` sets satchels and the building goes down at once when the timer expires. `blade` grinds: it drains structural HP every tick, so the building crumbles as it works and damage it has already taken counts. Absent means `charges`, which is what every demolisher did before the field existed.

tunnel_charge_time_s.description: Seconds a `tunnel_charge` unit must hold station to set a tunnel collapse charge. Absent means 8.0. Longer than a building demolition: the team digs down to the void first.

construct_rate.description: Field works (#277): how fast a `construct` unit raises a field work, as a multiple of the type's build time. Absent means 1; the D9 authors 1.5. Two builders add.
